gorseller.istem: Circular badge-like composition centered in a square: a friendly hedgehog, a small owl perched on top of a low dry stone garden wall, and a glossy bronze legless slow worm peeking out from between the stones, framed by ivy and wildflowers, warm cream background. Simple, bold, readable at very small sizes, strong silhouettes.

Wide panoramic view along a low dry stone garden wall in a Turkish village courtyard at golden hour: a hedgehog, a small owl on the wall, a house gecko on the stones, a swallow on a wire, a toad near a watering can, and a glossy bronze legless slow worm under a flat stone, all small and spread along the wall; the whole central area of the image is a calm, plain, softly lit sky and blurred greenery with plenty of empty space for a title.
